272:t_003:1.en:
$$くらら$$
「...Did you go through that too, $$葵$$?」

272:t_003:3.en:
$$朔哉$$
「So that means you too, $$くらら$$...? Then $$ジョニー$$ and $$エイーダ$$ must have as well...」

272:t_003:4.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Yes... It felt like the blood all through my body was boiling.」

272:t_003:5.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「Sweet and aching... But an intense impulse welled up from deep inside my body...」

272:t_003:6.en:
$$葵$$
「So we all felt the same thing.」

272:t_003:7.en:
$$葵$$
「We've really turned into a proper team, haven't we?」

272:t_003:8.en:
$$くらら$$
「Looks like we're more alike than we thought.」

272:t_003:9.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$チームＤ$$ sure is fired up.」

272:t_003:11.en:
$$シモン$$
「For the first time in a long while... I was reminded of my journey of battles...」

272:t_003:12.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「A journey, huh... So where do you intend to head from here?」

272:t_003:13.en:
$$シモン$$
「Isn't it obvious! Higher, farther... and stronger!」

272:t_003:14.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units. Since we can't confirm our current situation, damage to our warships could be fatal to all of us.」

272:t_003:15.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, give priority to intercepting enemies that approach the $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ and $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$.」

272:t_003:16.en:
$$渓$$
「Everyone! Sorry, but this time you're going to have to protect us!」

272:t_003:17.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Roger! We'd be in trouble too if we lost the place we come back to!」

272:t_004:3.en:
$$メール$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$! What's wrong with $n!?」

272:t_004:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's nothing serious. I'm having them join the battle as is.」

272:t_004:5.en:
$$メール$$
「Uh... You are Miss $$スズネ$$... right...?」

272:t_004:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「We're doing this, $n. Wherever we are, we have to carve out our own path by our own strength...!」

272:t_005:0.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, commence attack! Wherever we are, we will survive without fail!」

272:t_006:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Heh heh! How do you like that, you $$バアル$$ punks!」

272:t_006:1.en:
$$恵子$$
「There goes $$勝平$$ again, getting carried away...!」

272:t_006:2.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「We won this time, but it gives me the chills to think of getting attacked by things like that over and over.」

272:t_007:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Huh? An enemy just got taken out all of a sudden.」

272:t_008:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$アンゲロイ$$...! So it's the $$サイデリアル$$!」

272:t_008:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But I've never seen a black type like that before...!」

272:t_009:1.en:
$$葵$$
「They're with the $$アンゲロイ$$, so they must be $$サイデリアル$$ forces, for sure!」

272:t_009:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「W-What's with those guys...! Just looking at them is making me feel strange...!」

272:t_009:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「My will to fight... is withering away...」

272:t_009:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Damn it...! Is someone like me actually scared!?」

272:t_009:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「No. It's awe at overwhelming power.」

272:t_009:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「When a small child has met an adult's anger, they do everything they can to beg forgiveness.」

272:t_009:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It isn't defiance or resistance. They apologize and fawn, just to wait out the anger, and lay their own helplessness bare.」

272:t_009:11.en:
$$號$$
「...The feeling of awe carved into humanity's genes... Those are... our true enemy...」

272:t_009:14.en:
$$隼人$$
「The fundamental calamity that 《$$ガイオウ$$》 spoke of... Isn't it $$バアル$$!?」

272:t_009:15.en:
$$渓$$
「B-But... when you look at those things, what $$號$$ said makes sense...!」

272:t_009:16.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「What is this...? Even facing a whole army of $$宇宙怪獣$$, I never felt like this...」

272:t_009:17.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We can't win... There's no way we can beat things like that!」

272:t_009:19.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「I can feel it... They're trying to eliminate us...!」

272:t_009:20.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「Dark and cold... and overwhelming power...」

272:t_009:21.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It seems they're the ones who teleported us here, too.」

272:t_009:22.en:
$$ギミー$$
「W-We're going to fight something like that...?」

272:t_009:27.en:
$n
「I... I refuse to submit to those things!!」

272:t_009:30.en:
$$シモン$$
「Awe or whatever, I don't care! If they're an enemy we'll have to fight anyway, we'll hit them with everything we've got!」

272:t_009:31.en:
$$ランド$$
「Damn right! If it's hell whether we advance or retreat, then let's go hit them with everything!」

272:t_009:33.en:
$$號$$
(That's right. That is what will save the universe.)

272:t_009:34.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All hands, you've made up your minds.」

272:t_009:37.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Those enemies are trying to kill our spirit...」

272:t_009:38.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「But we are alive! We can't let them beat us so easily!」

272:t_009:39.en:
$$葵$$
「I know! We'll set our lives ablaze!」
